blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Close the required combat-feedback and product-shell/UI gaps by making every reachable combat event audibly, visually, and measurably traceable to immutable authority, while delivering a borderless HUD and a fully navigable 100–200% responsive Settings flow without disturbing preserved movement, weapons, mission state, authored environment, or clean boot.

diagnosis.root_cause: Combat observers retain partial event channels, but shot receipts omit projected aim/hit endpoints and reticle deltas, while route-gated event and footstep evidence lacks complete retained bindings. Separately, absolute-positioned shell/HUD layouts expose an opaque route card and implementation instructions, and collapse Settings at 200% scale. Repeated work therefore needs direct authority-to-presentation receipt joining plus structural responsive reflow, not further transform tuning.

stop_conditions: Stop only after GameLoop Runtime and Tester pass both required phase checks and preserve `clean_boot`.
Do not use teleports, debug state setters, invulnerability, fabricated events, or pre-completed saves to obtain combat evidence.

If the independent legal-route blocker still prevents later event capture, retain the affected evidence issue and hand off the completed instrumentation; do not edit deferred world, AI, or progression debt in this iteration.
Stop and repair before handoff if mouse look, movement, reload/F6 separation, recoil recovery, pause, Home, Replay, checkpoint recovery, or persisted 100% UI scale regresses.
Do not claim shell completion from source inspection alone; both keyboard/mouse and gamepad navigation require rendered runtime evidence.

strategy.rationale: Use immutable event IDs to join authority, ballistics, presentation, audio, HUD, animation, damage, score, and cleanup receipts, then retain bounded rows across lifecycle boundaries. Repair UI through container-based safe-area layout and removal of prohibited surfaces, materially changing the repeated-work strategy while preserving existing authority and accepted assets.

code: Parse every changed GDScript and load each changed scene/resource; reject missing NodePaths, invalid signal bindings, duplicate connections and candidate-script errors.
Inspect the combat path to confirm presentation observers make no authoritative gameplay calls and all channels join through immutable event IDs.
Verify Settings uses safe-area/container sizing and focus-following scroll behavior rather than another scale-specific absolute-coordinate patch.
Confirm changed HUD and shell controls retain existing licensed fonts, live bindings and settings persistence.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime and Tester should enter unpaused captured-mouse gameplay through ordinary flow, record near/middle/long no-spread shots plus block, impact, hit, kill, damage and death cells, and correlate state, adjacent frames and native audio receipts.

Navigate title and pause Settings with keyboard/mouse and gamepad at 100% and 200%, exercise every control plus Apply/Cancel, restore 100%, restart, and verify `ui_scale=1.0` with the same page-state predicates.
Run the fixed FPS patrol for mouse look, walk/strafe, sprint, ADS, sustained AUTO fire and recoil return, reload on R, F6 reset, pause, Home, Replay and checkpoint recovery without restarting Godot.
After combat, UI transitions, reset and Replay callbacks, re-read runtime errors and preserve the clean-boot verdict.
visual: Compare normal gameplay and active fire, hit, kill, damage and death states against the bound imagination reference: compact upper HUD, restrained yellow right-side kill row, visible world scale and no opaque/debug cards.
Capture Settings at 1280×720 at both 100% and 200%, including first, middle and last focused controls plus Apply and Cancel; require no clipping, overlap, missing labels or unsafe anchoring.

Capture the deployment route cue and combat feed while visibly active at 100%; require borderless hierarchy, licensed typography and no minimap, countdown, reticle, enemy silhouette or viewmodel occlusion.
Retain the final matched 100% gameplay frame after the 200% stress probe and persisted restart.

done_when: Each ordinary shot exposes one immutable receipt containing origin, aim direction, authoritative aim/hit endpoint, result, screen projection, reticle center and recorded pixel delta; tracer, impact, damage and hit state share that shot ID.

The bounded matrix retains naturally generated player fire, blocked shot or miss, material impact, enemy fire or near miss, player damage, enemy hit, elimination and death channels across pause, reset, checkpoint, Home and Replay boundaries without submitting gameplay authority.

Active combat-feed rows use the licensed HUD typography, remain at the upper right with no more than five concise rows, and present hit, kill and death states without broad opaque cards, debug labels or false authority.

Footstep receipts identify exactly one owner, decoded stream path, bus, grounded/contact state and cadence for applicable player walk, sprint, crouch and landing plus enemy steps, with no duplicate emitters or synthesized placeholder tones.
Presentation channels reach the corresponding authoritative event within two rendered frames, have bounded lifetimes and cleanup, and do not replay duplicate damage, score, audio or VFX submissions.
tasks.instructions: Complete the combat-feedback capability through a direct immutable-event join. Extend authoritative shot output and the presentation observer so Tester can compare reticle, aim, endpoint, tracer, impact and damage spatially without changing shot authority. Retain bounded per-run rows for fire, miss/block, impact, damage, hit, kill and death, including animation, HUD, audio, score and cleanup timing. Expose native footstep ownership, stream, bus and cadence in the existing presentation snapshot. Finish the restrained right-side event feed using live values and existing licensed typography. Preserve current weapons, recoil, movement, mission progression and enemy authority; this task adds presentation and read-only qualification data, never debug shortcuts or synthetic combat outcomes.
tasks.title: Join authoritative combat feedback and retained receipts

done_when: At 1280×720 and 200% UI scale, every Settings control remains paired with its player-facing label, the focused control scrolls fully into view, and Apply and Cancel remain visibly reachable.
Settings contains no focus, scrolling, binding, component-readiness or other implementation-facing instructions; navigation is communicated through focus styling and ordinary affordances.
Deployment route guidance is a compact borderless live-state cue that preserves the world view and does not overlap the minimap, countdown, reticle, combat feed or weapon viewmodel.

Keyboard/mouse and gamepad can open Settings from title and pause, traverse every control, apply or cancel, return to the correct predecessor, then restore and persist `ui_scale=1.0` through the product settings path and restart.
Title, loadout, loading, briefing, gameplay, pause, ordinary-death and result page bindings retain their existing authoritative transitions, focus targets and truthful paused HUD behavior.
tasks.instructions: Replace the Settings page's coordinate-patching strategy with a safe-area responsive hierarchy: stable header, scrollable labeled setting rows, focus-following scrolling and a reachable action footer. Remove shipped navigation/debug instructions while preserving focus telemetry as read-only state. Replace the regressed deployment route card with compact borderless guidance driven by the same authoritative route event; use typography, spacing, outline and a tightly fitted low-alpha accent only if contrast requires it. Keep 200% as an accessibility stress state, restore 100% as the persisted default, and preserve the existing shell lifecycle rather than expanding into deferred terminal or progression work.
